decision: EQUIVALENT_IN_MEAN: |mean paired diff|=0.0027 < 0.01 margin; L12 (protected bf16) shows no systematic degradation vs L5 (plaintext-equivalent fp32). Per-seed diffs range -0.0092..0.0183; with only 3 seeds the 95% CI [-0.0325, 0.0378] is wide and does not by itself establish strict TOST equivalence — reported honestly.
notes: best-dev checkpoint selection + early stopping (patience 3) => seeds converge at different steps (sel 400-1400); within the frozen recipe.
per-example paired bootstrap over the 872 dev items requires raw per-example predictions, which these result JSONs do not store; seed-level paired stats reported instead.
L0 base floor 0.8853; both arms clear it by ~3 points.
